# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This is a special GitHub profile repository for **fareenlavji**. The README.md in this repository appears on the GitHub profile page.

## Repository Guidelines

### Purpose
- This repository contains the profile README that displays on the GitHub profile page
- Changes to README.md will be visible publicly on the profile

### Content Guidelines
- Keep content professional and concise
- Use markdown formatting for better readability
- Include relevant information about skills, interests, and projects
- Use emojis sparingly to enhance visual appeal

### Code Style
- Follow standard Markdown conventions
- Use proper heading hierarchy
- Ensure links are valid and functional
- Test any badges or dynamic content before committing

### Best Practices
- Keep the README engaging but not overly lengthy
- Update regularly to reflect current activities and interests
- Include contact information or ways to connect
- Consider adding stats, recent activity, or project highlights
- Ensure all content is appropriate for a public profile

### When Making Changes
- Preview markdown changes before committing
- Check that all links work correctly
- Verify that any embedded images or badges load properly
- Maintain consistency with the existing style and tone
